name: Kasagi Aoi
source:
Student council president, third year.

A talented woman who serves as the student council president. She is a cool beauty with long black hair and a calm and collected demeanor. Her sharp gaze and somewhat discerning eye makes the other student council members nervous in front of her. She talks in a strong-minded manner, and calls the protagonist by his first name. Usually, she is a woman of few words. Her height is around 170cm which is on the taller side. Her beautiful legs has attracted the gazes of the protagonist and the other boys whenever she comes up on stage. She is unstoppable when lovestruck, but only shows this side to the protagonist. She is also cute when she sulks.

She has always been interested with the protagonist. Even though she doesn't show it on the surface, Tsuboi-san completely saw through her. Ichika is a childhood friend of hers, and she sometimes helps with her studies. Aoi has become the one who asks for sex.

[Translated from [url=http://northbox.net/products/mahotsubo/character01.html]Official Site[/url]]
